rules.name: Missing Required Identifiers or Core Attributes
rules.description: Validates that essential loan metadata (loan_id, borrower_id, loan_type, principal, rate, term) are populated.

rules.name: Invalid Calendar Date Format
rules.description: Verifies that dates comply with ISO calendar bounds and do not contain impossible calendar values.

rules.name: Maturity Date Prior to Origination Date
rules.description: Maturity date must strictly succeed origination date in the loan lifecycle.

rules.name: Negative Loan Principal or Balance
rules.description: Original loan principal and current balance cannot be less than zero.

rules.name: Current Balance Exceeds Original Principal
rules.description: Standard amortizing loans cannot carry a current balance higher than original disbursed principal.

rules.name: Interest Rate Outside Acceptable Market Bounds
rules.description: Interest rate must fall within configured minimum and usury thresholds.

rules.name: Invalid Payment Status Enumeration
rules.description: Payment status must strictly match standardized servicing status values.

rules.name: Payment Status vs Days Past Due Inconsistency
rules.description: Servicing payment status must align with the days past due bracket.

rules.name: Duplicate Primary Loan Identifier
rules.description: Each loan identifier must be unique across the portfolio.

rules.name: Duplicate Borrower Origination Triplet
rules.description: Flags duplicate loans sharing identical borrower_id, original principal, and origination date.

rules.name: Missing or Incomplete Document Custody Status
rules.description: Ensures document status is recorded and not unassigned.

rules.name: Stale Tape Record Exceeding Update Window
rules.description: Last updated date exceeds the allowed freshness threshold (180 days).

rules.name: Invalid US State Jurisdiction Code
rules.description: Borrower state must be a valid 2-letter US jurisdiction code.

rules.name: Paid-Off Loan Carrying Positive Balance
rules.description: A loan marked PAID_OFF or CLOSED must have a zero current balance.

rules.name: Cross-Source Servicer Feed Discrepancy
rules.description: Flags discrepancies between primary tape data and external servicer update feeds.
